script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: Rabbah is labeled a region, but it was a city—the chief city of the Ammonites.
“Last of the Rephaim” is broader than Deuteronomy 3:11, which says Og was the only one remaining of the remnant of the Rephaim.

Jeremiah’s and Ezekiel’s warnings concern Rabbah, but the cited passages do not say the warnings were delivered there. They describe future judgment, not events reported as having already happened at Rabbah.
Words such as “besieged,” “plunder,” and “cubits” may be difficult for a 5th-grade reader. Use simpler wording or explain them.
